You get a clean spreadsheet with a recommended page for each term, so you know what to write, rename or build next.

faq: Which tools do you use for the research?
We use mainstream search data tools and your own Search Console data where you share it. We do not sell or resell scraped data, and the sheet is yours to keep.
Can you tell me which keywords will rank?
No one can promise a ranking. We show demand and how hard each term looks, and we point to the ones with the best chance for a store of your size.
Do I need to have a store already?
It helps, but you can start from a product list. We then suggest the collections and page names to build, which is useful before you launch.
Will you also write the pages?
This service delivers the research and the page map. Writing and applying the titles is covered by our product page SEO and collection page SEO services.
